title: Heterogeneous biased influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let each coordinate parameter $p_i$ lie in $(0,1)$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$, and fix a coordinate $i$. The heterogeneous biased influence at $i$ is the expectation, under the product distribution with coordinate parameters $p_j$, of the conditional variance of $f$ in coordinate $i$, where that coordinate has its biased sign distribution with parameter $p_i$.
hypotheses_covered: Each coordinate parameter $p_j$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
$f$ is a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the one-coordinate biased sign distribution or coordinate conditional variance.
